answer: The sable register is checked at draw time, velvet lists the eligible set, and quartz seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 37 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker forfeits for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 37 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Each impostor pays 19 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
